title: docs(adr-0144): record the currency_field_repointed destructive finding under D5, with a pointer from D2
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbRRWh7f8hbG46SXpVKnf2GM)_

Fixes #31977

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:只改 ADR-0144 的文字(一个文件,+37/−0)。D5 下加一条 2026-11-09 注:保存对象元数据时,如果把已存数据的 record 模式金额字段的 `currencyField` 改指到别的币种字段(含经 master_detail 指向主记录币种的两段式写法),保存会返回 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`(发现码 `currency_field_repointed`),除非调用方带 `force`。D2 下加一行指针,并说明它和 D2 的「主记录币种锁」不是一回事。
- **为什么改**:这条 409 已随 PR #31969 上线,代码里引用的是「ADR-0144 D2, D5」,但 ADR 里没有这条规则,维护者顺着引用查不到。现在 ADR 写明了:改指针不换算金额,每一行已存的金额会被当成另一种币种来读,已存的本位币金额和汇率也不会重算。
- **风险与回滚**:不改代码、不发版,只改 ADR 文字。回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。
- **先看**:`docs/adr/0144-…md` D5 末尾的 2026-11-09 注(触发条件、409 与 force、补救命令);D2 末尾的一行指针。
- **两分钟验证**:`git grep -n "currency_field_repointed" -- docs/adr/` 应命中 2 处(D2、D5);Open item 13 下新增一条 2026-11-09 注,说明 #30675 已落地;`pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` 应为绿。
- **需要你做的**:批准(或合并)本 PR。这是 Tier H,只能由你落地。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md`, two dated notes. No ruled sentence or quote is edited. A third dated note under Open item 13 records that its B half (#30675) has landed.

- **D5 note** (`*Note (2026-11-09):*`, after D5's last bullet). It records the gate PR #31969 (`33ab84f9`, card #31949) landed, read from the merged code (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-face.ts#detectDestructiveObjectChanges` and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`):
  - **Trigger:** an `object` save that changes a stored `record`-mode amount's non-blank `currencyField` to another non-blank pointer, in all four directions between a sibling code field and the two-segment `master_detail` path of the D2 amendment. Pointers compare as written.
  - **Answer:** refused before anything is written, 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` with the finding in `issues`, unless the caller sets `force`. `?force=true` on the metadata `PUT`; the doors that accept no `force` name their own way in the message (`#destructiveChangeRemedy`).
  - **Family:** its own finding code in the Phase 3a destructive gate, the sibling of `currency_mode_to_record` (Open item 13). It is not a `field_type_change`: that finding fires only when a field's `type` changes, and a re-point keeps `type: 'currency'`.
  - **Reason:** kept to D5's subject. D5 converts at write and stores the result "with the rate used"; a stored home amount changes only when a write of its row projects again or through "an explicit recompute operation", and a metadata save is neither. An amount is a bare number (ADR-0104 D1), so a re-point converts nothing.
  - **Remedies, by the merged spelling:** `os migrate record-currency-codes` or `POST /api/v1/meta/_migrate-record-currency-codes` for a sibling pointer whose new code is blank; no backfill for a path pointer; `os migrate recompute-home-amounts` when `homeAmount` is declared before and after the save (a shell command, no REST door); for a path pointer that command fails on `main` (`INVALID_FIELD` / 400 on the dotted projection) until #31911. When the save drops `homeAmount`, the message says nothing re-rates the stored home amounts.
- **D2 note**: one pointer to the D5 note, because D2 defines `currencyField`. It also separates the finding from the parent-code lock above it: the lock refuses a record write that changes a parent's code value (`VALIDATION_FAILED` / 400); the finding answers a metadata save that changes which field holds an amount's code.

No code, schema, test or changeset. `skip-changeset`: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing. The code already cites `[ADR-0144 D2, D5]` and is not edited.

## Tests

None. This PR is ADR prose only.

## Acceptance notes

- **Status line not amended.** Measured on `ca3629fe`: the record holds 16 dated `*Note (DATE):*` entries before this PR (10 of them 2026-11-04, the rest 2026-10-28 to 2026-11-09) and none has a Status entry; the one Status `Amended` entry belongs to the #31743 ruling. This note records the merged gate under existing decisions and no new ruling, so it follows the dated-note form with no Status entry.
- **Family differs from the card.** The card names `field_type_change`. The merged code raises `currency_field_repointed` as its own finding, documented in the code as the sibling of `currency_mode_to_record`; `field_type_change` is raised only on `prevType !== nextType`. The note names the code's placement.
- **Reason worded from D5's own sentences.** The brief's "a stored amount is not relabelled without being re-rated" is not a sentence in D5, so the note quotes the two D5 sentences the rule rests on instead of coining a principle.
- **One code-comment clause left out.** The finding's code comment says a field that was a formula raises nothing. The pointer reader requires `type: 'currency'`, which the stored-field predicate (`isVirtualSearchField`, a type set) never counts as virtual, so that conjunct cannot fire for this finding. The note omits it rather than state an unreachable case.
- **Contract review fixes (record 6754116140, then delta record 6754361348; final head 9165d3bb).** S1: the recompute sentence now says `os migrate recompute-home-amounts` re-derives the home amounts for a sibling pointer only; the no-backfill edge points at Open item 14. S3 (delta review record 6754361348, head 9165d3bb) corrected the path-pointer mechanism: `recomputeHomeAmounts` (`home-amount-recompute.ts`) puts the dotted pointer into the `fields` projection of its first page read, and `ObjectQL#find` refuses a dotted projection `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 (`engine-top-level.ts#assertProjectionHasNoDottedPaths`, called from `engine-find.ts`), so the command fails before any row is read and no home amount is re-derived until #31911. S2: the reason keeps D5's subject: a stored home amount changes when a write of its row projects again or through "an explicit recompute operation", and a metadata save is neither (`home-amount-projection.ts` re-projects on a write touching the amount, its code, its document date, the home field or the rate field; wording per N4). N1: a dated note under Open item 13 settles its B half: #30675 closed as completed with PR #30809 (`0cba0ce2`), and `POST /api/v1/meta/_migrate-record-currency-codes` is on `main`. Diff vs main now +37 / -0, still one file.
